claims.statement: Tom Allen was in New Orleans on 7 July 1889, taking a lemonade in the rotunda of the St. Charles Hotel.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the famous pugilist, taking a lemonade inthe rotunda of the St. Charles Hotel.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he was for Kilrain when asked for his opinion before the Sullivan-Kilrain fight.
claims.excerpt: He was asked for his opinion. He said, ‘I am for Kilrain.”

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Kilrain's condition was good but that he would like him better if he were not so fat.

notes: Allen's name also appears in a garbled list of pugilists at the hotel; not used. Allen is not in the fight itself.
